name: Unidentified one-eye-stalk species
description: A sentient species was distinguished by their tall eyestalk and solid eye perched atop their head, with a large, pointed ear also extending outward from each side, as well as a wide mouth with pronounced lips, what seemed like bristly hair growing from chin, and bony necks that folded inward. By 22 BBY, a member of this species had been a Jedi of the Jedi Order, well known enough to have multiple busts of them displayed around the Jedi Archives.
